subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: This 6-day winter tour flies China Southern Airlines from Manila via Guangzhou to Harbin. You visit Harbin Ice-Snow World, the Middle East Railway Bridge, the Baroque-style old street, Chateau Volga and the Siberian Tiger Park, with an optional day trip to Yabuli, Asia’s largest ski resort. Hotels are 5-star, and one lunch is upgraded to Ice Palace hot pot and one meal to BBQ.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 6–11 2027 to Jan 13–18 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Yabuli Ski Resort: One of Asia's largest ski resorts, in the mountains east of Harbin.
placeDesc.Middle East Railway Bridge: A historic railway bridge in Harbin built in the early 20th century.
placeDesc.Baroque-style Old Street: A Harbin street of well-preserved European Baroque-style buildings.
placeDesc.Harbin Ice-Snow World: A winter theme park of giant ice and snow sculptures that is lit up at night.
placeDesc.Chateau Volga: A Russian-style manor park in Harbin built around Russian culture and architecture.
placeDesc.St. Nicholas Church: A Russian Orthodox church building in the Volga Manor park.
placeDesc.Vodka Fort: A Russian-themed attraction where the tour includes a small vodka and a snack.
placeDesc.Pushkin Exhibition Hall: An exhibition hall in Harbin devoted to the Russian poet Pushkin.
placeDesc.Siberian Tiger Park: A wildlife park near Harbin dedicated to breeding and viewing Siberian tigers.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's best-known pedestrian street, lined with European-style buildings.
placeDesc.Stalin Park: A riverside park in Harbin along the Songhua River.
placeDesc.Flood Control Monument: A monument on the Songhua River in Harbin, commemorating a historic flood.
placeDesc.Sophia Church Square: The square around the Byzantine-style Saint Sophia Cathedral in Harbin.
placeDesc.Giant Snowman Sculpture: A large snowman snow sculpture in Harbin, visited as a photo stop before the airport.
